text: 中国财政部发行63天期债券，规模200亿元，发行利率1.0316%，边际利率1.0913%，预期1.0400%，投标倍数3.58倍，边际倍数1.14倍
text_en: China's Ministry of Finance issues 63-day bonds worth 20 billion yuan, with an issuance rate of 1.0316%, marginal rate of 1.0913%, expected 1.0400%, bid-to-cover ratio of 3.58 times, and marginal ratio of 1.14 times
